verdicts.reason: Both keep the original's three-column structure (headline, window, details), but the stained-glass window is much smaller and no longer the strong centrepiece it was. A keeps comfortable side margins and good balance, though the window is a bit small. B's larger headline and details run very close to the canvas edges, with only about 10px on the right, which makes it feel cramped, and the window is pinched between the text blocks.
